intro.title: Designing data-intensive apps
intro.body: In this lesson, you will design a simplified model for a data-intensive application, focusing on how to handle large volumes of data efficiently. You will learn core system design concepts like scalability, reliability, and maintainability by structuring key components. The main constructs involved include defining data models, identifying system boundaries, and planning for growth. This beginner-friendly introduction will help you understand the foundational principles needed to build robust, data-driven systems.
intro.usecase: Data-intensive applications power the core functionality of modern digital products that process large volumes of information in real-time. Examples include social media feeds that continuously load and filter posts, e-commerce platforms with complex product catalogs and search filters, and financial dashboards that aggregate and visualize live transaction data. As a developer, you'll implement these patterns when building recommendation engines that process user behavior data, analytics tools that handle streaming metrics, or content management systems that manage millions of records with efficient querying and caching strategies.
